## Passages
RESULT [weeds]: The 4B model reached 75.82% exact-set precision at IoU 0.5, with 89.30% precision and 87.81% recall. The authors report it outperforming GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.1-Pro, Qwen3-VL-30B-Instruct and Gemma-4-31B-it.
US [weeds]: Bears on the VLM-vs-YOLO benchmark and the labeller agent. A small open model trained for the domain can beat frontier general models at weed grounding, which supports running the labeller or reviewer brain as a domain-tuned open model on the cluster, not a general-purpose LLM. Their species-set precision metric is a stricter labeller-quality measure than box mAP.
CORRECTION [weeds]: Confirmed: 4B model; 37 species from six datasets; 75.82% exact-set precision, 89.30% precision, 87.81% recall; beats GPT-5.4 (46.0), Gemini-3.1-Pro (61.58), Qwen3-VL-30B-Instruct (47.95) and Gemma-4-31B-it (44.55) on the strict metric. The method is GRPO with format, accuracy and count rewards.
